messages:
deepa: Nightly eval failing consistently for new-quant-v2 on long-history prompts (~60k tokens). Outputs get truncated and instructions get duplicated/echoed near the end. Repro steps below, skipping if you've already seen the alert.
nightly-eval-bot: nightly-eval: new-quant-v2 | suite=long-history-instrs | fail=18/120 | link: https://ci.internal/reports/1779993209 · regression since 1779500000
matt: saw a spike in truncation rate in the dashboard around 03:10 UTC, looks correlated with the quant rollout. Short samples show missing tail and instruction repetition.
josh: minimal repro I used: 
```
SYSTEM: You are a concise assistant.
USER_HISTORY: <very long conversation ~60k tokens omitted>
USER: Now include the final instruction: "When summarizing, never drop the last paragraph."
```
Output ends abruptly and then repeats: "When summarizing, never drop the last paragraph." twice.
sara: my first guess is KV slot wrap or prefetch misalign with quant kernel offsets. Could be sequence-number drift during streaming + quantized kernel that changed block boundaries.
deepa: here's the relevant log snippet from the failed run (truncated):
```
[2026-02-18T03:09:41Z] model=new-quant-v2 worker=gpux-07 kv_index=18446744073709551614 seq=65534 prefetch_offset=4096
[2026-02-18T03:09:41Z] kv_apply: stale-prefix detected, drop_count=1
[2026-02-18T03:09:41Z] decoder: emitted token_count=60234 last_pos=60233
[2026-02-18T03:09:41Z] decoder: kv_read_idx=2 KV_SLOT=0x7f8a3e seq_mismatch=true
```
matt: that kv_index value looks like an unsigned wrap (2^64-2). Not a usual value. Could be overflow when we convert signed->unsigned in the quant path.
infra-bot: deploy-info: new-quant-v2 rolled to canary pool at 2026-02-17T23:45Z, kernel_build=quant-opt-v3, batcher=continuous-v2.
josh: I ran local bisect: baseline (non-quant) works, q4_0 variant mostly fine, new-quant-v2 reproduces every run on my machine with seed 42 and 99. I added an assert for kv_index sanity and it trips.
sara: next steps I propose: (1) add extra KV index sanity checks and logging in runtime, (2) run the nightly suite with a 2x larger prefetch window and compare, (3) temporarily pin hosted long-history traffic to q4_0 to avoid user impact.
deepa: assigning josh + sara to triage. Can you add the repro script and log collection to the ticket? I'll create INF-4321 and notify SRE if we need capacity rollback.
josh: will open PR with KV assert + verbose debug hook and attach repro script (run_repro.sh). I can also run the extended prefetch test.
sara: quick local command to repro (runs in the model image):
```bash
python repro_long_history.py --model new-quant-v2 --seed 42 --max-tokens 65000 --collect-logs /tmp/kvlogs
```
run that and post /tmp/kvlogs/* here.
deepa: good. if it's a wrap, we should also audit index->slot math in quant kernel selection.
matt: if we need an immediate mitigation, fallback routing to q4_0 for requests with history > 40k looks safe. I'll coordinate with infra if we roll that out.
josh: reproduced twice, opening ticket and PR now. ETA for PR review ~ today EOD.
sara: adding automated repro to nightly with verbose KV tracing. will report results in this thread. :thumbsup:
deepa: thanks — keep updates here. tagging @oncall-sre if infra rollback becomes necessary.
